messages:
maria: quick async standup — what I did:
- landed kernel prefetch change (reduce lock churn)
- ran microbench and a 1k-iter kv/slot perf sweep
blockers:
- an integration test `kv_eviction_test` is flaky under higher load (failing assertion on slot reclaim)
today:
- debug the test, adjust prefetch depth for canary, open PR for CI smoke

alex: can you paste the failing log snippet?

maria: here's the tail of the failing run:
```
2024-05-14T09:12:03.812Z ERROR kv::evict - reclaim failed: slot not found (id=0x3fa7)
...
AssertionError: expected slot_count <= 512 but got 643
```

riley: hmm looks like a race when slot eviction and batch flush happen concurrently — seen similar when slot-timeout is low. could be prefetch holding refs longer.

sam: FYI I kicked a micro-canary for prefetch on staging (10% traffic) a few mins ago, no restarts yet :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: kernel-prefetch-v2 -> staging (10%)

jen: quick Q — do we have a KV hit-rate / mem-pressure dashboard for that canary? want a link to monitor.

maria: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefetch?orgId=1 (watch evict_rate, mem_peak, slot_count)

alex: eviction looks to spike at ~0.8 mem, prefetch increases reuse but also transient mem pressure. suggestion: lower prefetch_depth to 4 for canary.

maria: running bench with prefetch_depth=4: `./bench/run_kv_bench --prefetch_depth=4 --iters=1000 --concurrency=32`
riley: add `--slot-timeout=50ms` to reproduce reclaim timing if you want to stress it.

maria: updated bench results (quick summary): 95p latency 42ms -> 38ms, p99 120ms -> 110ms, mem_peak ~82% (unchanged). attaching CSV to the PR.

sam: cool — that improvement seems safe. promote to 25% after 1 hour of telemetry? :thumbsup:

maria: plan: wait 1h on 10% with prefetch_depth=4, then 25% if no evict_rate spike. I'll open PR to adjust canary config.

alex: I'll take the flaky `kv_eviction_test` after you. ping me when you have a repro.

maria: will ping. also will add a small test tweak to reduce timing flakiness (and file an e2e that runs with slot-timeout=50ms).

jen: small follow-up for CI — can we add a fast smoke that runs the bench with prefetch_depth=4 so future PRs don't regress perf?

alex: +1, tiny job in CI makes sense.

maria: will open both PRs today (canary config + CI smoke).

riley: I'll add an alert on kv_evict_rate > 100/s for staging so we can rollback quickly.

sam: logged an incident template if it spikes, but sounds fine for today.

maria: thanks all — updating the sprint board and will post PR links here when ready.

alex: thanks, will help with the test.

jen: thanks — appreciate the quick checks.

maria: end of standup.
